name: Willow & Forde
description:
Willow and Forde – Marquee Hire Website
I developed the website for Willow and Forde, a dedicated marquee hire company based in the picturesque town of Retford, North Nottinghamshire. Using WordPress along with custom HTML, CSS, and PHP, and designed through Elementor, the website combines elegant design with strong performance. It captures the brand’s warm and personal identity while providing visitors with a clear overview of their services. I implemented both image and video optimization to ensure fast loading times and smooth performance across all devices. The site is fully responsive, SEO-friendly, and structured to offer a visually engaging and professional experience, reflecting the passion and quality that Willow and Forde bring to their events. This project showcases my ability to create tailored web solutions that highlight the unique charm and offerings of local businesses.

name: Liyu Holdings
description:
Liyu Holdings – Innovative Tech Portfolio Website
I developed the portfolio website for Liyu Holdings, a forward-thinking technology company on a mission to modernize Ethiopia’s market landscape. Focused on replacing outdated brokerage systems like the traditional delala, Liyu Holdings creates smart, accessible digital platforms that foster trust, efficiency, and economic growth. Built with WordPress, the website features custom animations and a modern, responsive design that visually reinforces the company’s innovative spirit. This project highlights my ability to craft clean, engaging websites that combine strategic messaging with interactive design, effectively showcasing the bold vision of a tech-driven enterprise.

name: ByMeklit
description:
ByMeklit is a fully functional online store built on WordPress with WooCommerce as the core e-commerce engine. I developed the site end-to-end, focusing on clean UI/UX, scalable product management, and smooth checkout flows.

To enhance mobile accessibility and improve user retention, I implemented a Progressive Web App (PWA) layer. This allows customers to browse products, add items to cart, and engage with the brand using an app-like experience directly from their mobile devices without requiring an app store download.

name: Aleksir IT Solutions
description:
Aleksirit – Digital Marketing Agency Website
I designed and developed Aleksirit, a sleek and modern website for a digital marketing company, using WordPress along with custom HTML, CSS, and PHP. Built with Elementor, the site offers a seamless blend of performance, responsiveness, and visual appeal. I followed best practices throughout the development process to ensure clean code, fast loading times, and full accessibility across all devices. The website effectively communicates the agency’s services, showcases their expertise, and maintains a consistent brand identity. It features a responsive layout, custom styling, smooth animations, SEO optimization, and user-friendly integrations, all crafted to provide a professional and engaging user experience. Aleksirit reflects my ability to combine creative design with solid technical execution, resulting in a high-quality online presence tailored to the client's goals.

name: Big Smoke Bar
description:
Big Smoke Bar & Steak House – Restaurant Website with Ordering & Reservations
I developed the website for Big Smoke Bar & Steak House, a luxurious, modern dining destination in East London known for its premium steaks, gourmet burgers, cocktails, and shisha experience. Built with WordPress and WooCommerce, the site features a full food ordering system and a seamless table reservation platform, allowing customers to book their spot or place orders with ease. The design captures the vibrant atmosphere of the restaurant, with stylish visuals and responsive performance across all devices. This project showcases my ability to build elegant, functional websites for high-end hospitality venues, integrating eCommerce and booking features for a complete customer experience.

name: Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant
description:
Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant – Website Design and Development
I built the official website for Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant, one of London’s well-known destinations for authentic Ethiopian cuisine. Developed using WordPress with custom HTML, CSS, and PHP, and designed through Elementor, the website delivers a visually rich and responsive experience that captures the warmth and culture of the restaurant. In addition to a strong design and seamless navigation, I implemented a complete table booking system with automated email notifications to streamline reservations for both customers and staff. The site is fully optimized for performance, mobile accessibility, and SEO, making it easy for visitors to explore the menu, book a table, and connect with the restaurant online. This project demonstrates my ability to create functional, attractive, and user-focused websites tailored to the unique needs of hospitality businesses.

Crystal White – Online Makeup School Platform
I developed the website for Crystal White, a professional online makeup school offering a complete virtual learning experience tailored for the beauty industry. Built with WordPress and WooCommerce, the platform supports multiple payment methods including Klarna, PayPal, Stripe, Google Pay, and Apple Pay. The site features seamless integration with Google Meet and Zoom for live classes, along with protected and optimized video content to ensure secure and smooth playback. It includes a robust learning management system with exams, grading, announcements, and automated email notifications for class updates and performance results. Both students and instructors benefit from clean, intuitive dashboards designed for efficient course management and learning progress tracking. Fully responsive and performance-optimized, Crystal White showcases my ability to build feature-rich eLearning platforms that combine education, commerce, communication, and security in a seamless digital environment.
name: Crystal White
Syaala
description: I built the official website for Syaala Infra, a company developing next-generation GPU colocation infrastructure starting with a purpose-built, AI-optimized 20-ft module in Memphis. The site is built with SvelteKit (Svelte 5) and Tailwind CSS, featuring a sleek dark theme, smooth interactions, and ultra-fast performance. It is fully responsive, lightweight, and optimized for showcasing Syaala’s engineering-focused approach.compliance.

name: Rolelx Inn
description:
Rolex Inn – Restaurant & Event Booking Website
I built the website for Rolex Inn, a luxury dining and cultural venue located in the heart of East London, where elegance meets vibrant hospitality. Developed using WordPress and designed with Elementor, the site combines aesthetic appeal with powerful functionality. I integrated WooCommerce to enable seamless event ticket sales, complete with automated PDF ticket generation and email delivery upon booking. Each ticket features a unique QR code for easy verification at the venue, ensuring a smooth and professional check-in process. The website is fully responsive, optimized for performance, and designed to highlight the restaurant’s rich cultural atmosphere, exceptional service, and unforgettable experiences. This project demonstrates my ability to deliver tailored web solutions that blend hospitality, eCommerce, and event management into one cohesive platform.

name: Reportzon
description:
Reportzon – SaaS Portfolio Website
I built the website for Reportzon, a tech company that connects Amazon and Google Sheets to keep data synced across spreadsheets 24/7. Developed using WordPress, the site is simple yet effective, designed to clearly communicate the company’s value proposition and services. The layout is clean, responsive, and performance-optimized, making it easy for visitors to understand the product and get in touch. Although minimal in structure, the site maintains a professional look and feel, showcasing my ability to create streamlined, informative websites for SaaS and tech-driven businesses.

name: Highgate Black Women
description:
Highgate Black Women – Herbal Products & Event Management Website
I developed the website for Highgate Black Women, a London-based online shop offering herbal soaps and traditional spices, specifically curated for Black women. Built with WordPress and WooCommerce, the site delivers a seamless and engaging shopping experience, with PayPal integration for secure and convenient payments. In addition to the eCommerce functionality, I implemented an event management system that allows the brand to promote and manage community events directly through the site, including event listings, bookings, and attendee tracking. The website is fully responsive, optimized for speed and usability, and designed to reflect the brand’s mission of empowerment, wellness, and cultural connection. This project demonstrates my ability to combine online retail with event functionality in a cohesive, user-friendly platform.

name: Oboleyan Coffee
description: I developed the website for Oboleyan Coffee Export PLC, a premium Ethiopian coffee exporter with over 20 years of heritage in delivering the finest Arabica beans to the global market. Built with Svelte and crafted with a focus on speed, responsiveness, and clean design, the site highlights the brand’s rich story, product quality, and global export capabilities. It offers an elegant browsing experience that reflects the culture and legacy behind Ethiopian coffee while providing a smooth interface for product exploration and inquiries. This project showcases my ability to create polished, performance-driven export websites that blend storytelling, visual quality, and technical excellence into a compelling digital presence.

name: Wrench360
description:
Wrench360 – Automotive Tech Portfolio Website
I developed the website for Wrench360, a forward-thinking platform aimed at transforming operations in the automotive repair industry through smart, adaptable technology. Built with WordPress and designed using Elementor, the site focuses on strong visual appeal and a clean, modern aesthetic that reflects the brand’s innovative spirit. While the website is relatively simple in structure, the emphasis was placed on delivering a polished, professional look that communicates trust and forward momentum. Fully responsive and optimized for user experience, the site effectively introduces Wrench360’s mission to simplify complex processes and support automotive businesses in staying competitive. This project highlights my design-first approach when building sleek, purpose-driven portfolio websites.

name: Shita Shito
description:
Shita Shito – Luxury Perfume eCommerce Website
I developed the online store for Shita Shito, a luxury perfume brand offering premium fragrances to customers in Ethiopia and beyond. Built using WordPress and WooCommerce, the website delivers a refined, high-end shopping experience tailored to match the elegance of the brand. I integrated the Chapa payment gateway to support local payment systems like Telebirr and other Ethiopian methods, ensuring smooth and secure transactions for customers. The store is also connected to the WooCommerce mobile app, enabling effortless product and order management for the client on the go. Fully responsive and optimized for performance and usability, the Shita Shito website reflects my ability to create modern, functional eCommerce platforms that support both local business needs and global standards.

name: Pilot CX
description:
I developed Pilot CX, a portfolio and business website, using SvelteKit with the latest Svelte 5 syntax. I implemented Tailwind CSS for styling and Shadcn-svelte for a consistent, component-based UI system.

On the backend, I worked with Drizzle ORM and MySQL to ensure type-safe queries and maintainable database schema management. For the admin-only dashboard, I built a custom authentication flow inspired by the best principles of Lucia Auth, providing secure access control without relying on deprecated libraries.

To enrich the user experience, I integrated Rive animations for smooth, interactive visuals. The project was deployed on a cPanel shared hosting environment, which required careful optimization to maintain reliability and performance.

Through this project, I combined modern frontend development, secure backend practices, and creative animation to deliver a polished platform that balances functionality with engaging design.

name: Wysemonk
description:
Wysemonk – Outsourcing & Tech Solutions Website
I designed and developed the website for Wysemonk, a dynamic technology company that offers smart outsourcing solutions to help businesses scale efficiently. Built with WordPress and Elementor, and enhanced with custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, the site delivers a modern, high-performance experience tailored to communicate Wysemonk’s value proposition: “Outsource Smart, Grow Faster.” The design emphasizes clarity, professionalism, and trust, guiding visitors through the company’s services with engaging visuals and smooth interactions. I focused on optimizing the site for speed, responsiveness, and SEO, ensuring a seamless user experience across all devices. Wysemonk’s website reflects the company’s forward-thinking approach and highlights my ability to create sleek, functional platforms for service-based businesses.

name: Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant
description:
Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant – Website Design and Development
I developed the website for Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant, a vibrant and welcoming Ethiopian dining destination in London. Built with WordPress and designed using Elementor, along with custom HTML, CSS, and PHP, the website delivers a smooth, visually engaging experience that reflects the rich culture and flavors of Ethiopia. The site features a fully responsive design, showcasing the restaurant’s menu, story, and ambiance, while also including an integrated booking system with automated email notifications to simplify table reservations. Optimized for speed, mobile usability, and SEO, the website offers an intuitive and inviting user experience. This project highlights my ability to create polished, functional websites that meet the needs of hospitality businesses while capturing their unique identity.

name: ByMeklit Help
description: I developed the Help Section for ByMeklit.shop using SvelteKit with the latest Svelte 5 syntax, creating a responsive and modern interface styled with Tailwind CSS. The backend is powered by Drizzle ORM with MySQL, allowing efficient management of help articles. The system includes a full dashboard where administrators can add, edit, and delete articles using a rich text editor, as well as send professional emails directly from the platform. This project demonstrates my ability to build a full-stack solution that combines modern frontend design, reliable backend architecture, and practical administrative tools in a cohesive and scalable way.
